title: Exact Hive Certificates for the Balanced-Inertia Stability Constants (N = 3 to 12) in Every Dimension, the $(A_N,B)$ Cost Law, and the Twenty-Two-Form Six-Level Cost Formula
abstract: For a traceless Hermitian $F$ with $N$ positive, $N$ negative and $d-2N$ zero eigenvalues, the inverse self-commutator cost $\kappa_d(F)$ satisfies $\delta_d\ge\gamma_{N,d}D_*$ with an optimal rational constant $\gamma_{N,d}$; the values $\gamma_2,\dots,\gamma_5$ were known and $\gamma_6,\dots,\gamma_{10}$ only numerically. We give exact, independently machine-checked certificates proving $\gamma_{N,d}=\gamma_N$ for $N=3,\dots,12$ and every $d\ge2N$: $17/36$, $4/7$, $113/152$, $9/10$, $781/740$, $317/264$, $23/17$, $3/2$, $773/468$, $289/160$. The minimising pairs switch at $N=7$ from $(A_N,B)$ to $(u_3,z_N)$. The certificates are exact rational hive primals at every positive-distance vertex of the finite reduction and matching duals at the listed minimisers, and dimension-independent Horn combinations (Weyl, two size-two and Lidskii–Wielandt inequalities) at the minimisers, written out in full. We also prove the $(A_N,B)$ cost law for $N\le14$ and the exact six-level formula $\kappa_6=\max$ of twenty-two explicit linear forms, all exposed. The supplied package reports a separate adversarial replay; fresh checks using separately written code are documented in Section 7, with provenance limits stated explicitly.
